'''Jayke Ball Mind what you haven't learned''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Jayke Ball]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10668">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10668 Mind what you haven't learned], DeckTech (Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball, 25 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10668/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10668/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018114125/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10668/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jayke Ball]]
* '''Published:''' 25 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Mind what you haven't learned''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MWYHL Ball LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Docking Bay: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Uses the MWYHL objecitve, but doesn't jedi test. Manipulation is the key.

== Original post ==

'''Mind what you haven't learned'''
* '''Author:''' Jayke "Lord_vader20" Ball
* '''Published:''' September 25, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Uses the MWYHL objecitve, but doesn't jedi test. Manipulation is the key.

=== Strategy ===

USe the Objective to get Yoda at his hut, to subtact 2 from attrition. It also adds 4 to sense and alter. You also arent giving the opponet any force. Use Inserection to search for the docking bays where you get lots of activation. Go to whatever planet they are on and Beatdown. Use the Suprise assults, you have good destiny and can make them lose big if they have alot of guys.
